name: Influencer logs in via OAuth with the Instagram token from Firestore
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/login.feature.spec.js › User Login › Influencer logs in via OAuth with the Instagram token from Firestore

steps.name: When the influencer authenticates via the Instagram OAuth simulation
Then the response status should be 200
And the OAuth response should contain Instagram user data
OAuth simulation must return the Instagram username
the KMS-decrypted Instagram token must be valid
And the browser should hold the session cookie pair
session cookie must be set (have: session, session_sig)
And the authenticated user should have role "INFLUENCER"
